scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM
   AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS 
WHERE
 (EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT = '8888-08-08' OR EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT IS NULL OR LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT)) <=8 OR (NOT regexp_like(EBILL_EFF_DT, '[[:digit:]]{4}-[[:digit:]]{2}-[[:digit:]]{2}') )
 OR  (substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 1, 4) not between '0000' and '9999' OR
       substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 6, 2) not between '01' and '12' OR
       substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 9, 2) not between '01' and '31'))  OR 
 (EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT <> '8888-08-08' AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NOT NULL AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT <> ' ' AND LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) >=8 
 AND ( (NOT regexp_like(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, '[[:digit:]]{4}-[[:digit:]]{2}-[[:digit:]]{2}') )
 OR (substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 1, 4) not between '0000' and '9999' OR
       substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 6, 2) not between '01' and '12' OR
       substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 9, 2) not between '01' and '31'
      )
 OR TO_DATE(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) )

DELETE from AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE PF2
WHERE EXISTS(
Select PF1.GRGR_ID,PF1.SBSB_ID, PF1.EBILL_EFF_DT,PF1.EBILL_TERM_DT from AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE PF1 
JOIN 
(Select P1.GRGR_ID,P1.SBSB_ID  from AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE P1 
JOIN AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE P2 ON P1.GRGR_ID = P2.GRGR_ID AND P1.SBSB_ID= P2.SBSB_ID AND
((P1.EBILL_EFF_DT = P2.EBILL_EFF_DT )
OR ( to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND  ( (  (P2.EBILL_TERM_DT = '8888-08-08' 
         OR P2.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NULL 
         OR LENGTH(RTRIM(P2.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <= 8 ) AND to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')  ) OR ( to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(P2.EBILL_TERM_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))))
OR ( to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND   ( (  (P1.EBILL_TERM_DT = '8888-08-08' 
         OR P1.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NULL 
         OR LENGTH(RTRIM(P1.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <= 8 ) AND to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')  ) OR ( to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(P1.EBILL_TERM_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))))
)
GROUP BY P1.GRGR_ID,P1.SBSB_ID
Having COUNT(1)>2)  PT1 ON pt1.GRGR_ID = PF1.GRGR_ID AND  pt1.SBSB_ID = PF1.SBSB_ID
WHERE PF2.GRGR_ID = PF1.GRGR_ID AND  PF2.SBSB_ID = PF1.SBSB_ID )

scripts.text:
MERGE INTO  AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS1 
USING (SELECT EPS.*  FROM AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS   JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON EPS.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID  LEFT JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON EPS.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID IS NULL) EPS2

DELETE FROM  AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS1
WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT EPS.*  FROM AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS 
JOIN AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF EP 
      ON EPS.GRGR_ID = EP.GRGR_ID 
      AND EPS.SBSB_ID = EP.SBSB_ID 
      AND  ((EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT = '8888-08-08' 
         OR EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NULL 
         OR LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <= 8 ) AND to_date(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= EP.EBILL_TERM_DT)
WHERE EPS.GRGR_ID= EPS1.GRGR_ID AND EPS.SBSB_ID  = EPS1.SBSB_ID  AND EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT= EPS1.EBILL_EFF_DT AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT  = EPS1.EBILL_TERM_DT)
